Name: Sable - New Custom NPC
Author: FloranceBless
Description:
[font=Comic Sans MS][color=#fff2cc][center][size=4]Sable is a longtime friend of [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7313][size=3]Wilford's[/size][/url]﻿[size=4], a young witch who keeps her secrets.[/size][/center][center][size=4]Make friends with a new villager and immerse yourself in her mysterious history![/size]
[size=2][font=Courier New][color=#cccccc]TW // [/color][/font][font=Courier New][color=#cccccc]Scars / Smoking[/color][/font][/size][/center][/color][/font]
[center][img]https://i.postimg.cc/1RwS2hYF/Sableby-Florance-Bless.png[/img]﻿﻿[/center]                                                                            
[left][/left]                                                         [font=Courier New][color=#cccccc] 
[/color][/font][font=Comic Sans MS][color=#fff2cc][size=4]Sable appears in the game if you and Wilford have at least [/size][/color][/font][font=Comic Sans MS][color=#ff7700][size=4]4 hearts of friendship[/size][/color][/font][font=Comic Sans MS][color=#fff2cc][size=4]. After that, you need to go out in the morning (after 7:00 AM) to the bus stop to meet her.[/size][/color][/font][center][font=Comic Sans MS][color=#fff2cc][size=4]

[color=#ff0000][size=4]The First Meeting[/size][/color][color=#efefef][size=4]: [/size]
[size=3]You must reach at least 4 hearts of friendship with Wilford. After that go out to the bus stop in the morning time.
[/size][/color]
[size=4][color=#ff0000]1 ❤[/color][color=#efefef]: 
Go out into the city on a sunny morning.
[/color][/size]
[color=#ff0000][size=4]2 ❤[/size][/color][color=#efefef]:
[size=3]Visit Wilford's house when it rains.[/size]

[/color][color=#ff0000][size=4]4 ❤[/size][/color][color=#efefef]:
[size=3]Go up to the attic of the Wilford's house in the afternoon.[/size][/color]
[color=#ff0000]
[size=4]6 ❤[/size][/color][color=#efefef]: 
[size=3]Go up to the attic of the Wilford's house in the morning.[/size]
[/color]
[color=#ff0000][size=4]8 ❤[/size][/color][color=#efefef]: 
[size=3]You will receive a letter from the Wizard (you need to have at least 2 hearts of friendship with him). Come to the forest the same day at six o'clock in the evening.[/size]
[/color]
[color=#ff0000][size=4]10 ❤[/size][/color][color=#efefef]: 
[size=3]You will receive a letter from Sable. Visit East Woods.[/size][/color][color=#ff7700][size=4][/spoiler][/size][/color][/font]
